We select two generative tasks to evaluate cross-lingual zero-shot knowledge transfer: • XL-Sum: news summarization on the XL-Sum dataset . The model needs to generate a 1-2 sentences summary based on a 1-2 news paragraphs. • XQuAD: question answering dataset , the model needs to generate a short phrase answer based on a paragraph and a question about it appended in the end of the paragraph.
outputs: Summaries for news articles and short phrase answers to questions
Generated summaries for news articles and short answer spans for QA.

quote: The evaluation is performed with ROUGE-2 metric computed on the test sets and F-measure for XQuAD.
